instruction.name: vfrint.d
instruction.description: Round double-precision floating point elements in `a` to integers, using current rounding mode specified in `fscr`, and store as floating point numbers.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
